The Arizona Diamondbacks will be on the road, opening a three-game series versus the Seattle Mariners on Friday, May 29 at 10:10 p.m. ET.

Seattle has entered the game as underdogs four times this season and won twice. The Diamondbacks have put together a 15-7 record in games they were favored on the moneyline (winning 68.2% of those games). This season, Arizona has been the underdog 28 times and won 12, or 42.9%, of those games.
